title: 1.1.9 Classify the Task
description: Read each task from a school-lunch app and log which of the four phases it belongs to. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Classify the code-writing task
steps.instructions: Read the task. Log the name of the phase that task belongs to, using console.log. Choose from inception, elaboration, construction, or deployment.

steps.title: Classify the school-servicing task
steps.instructions: Log the phase name for this task.

steps.title: Classify the structure task
steps.instructions: Log the phase name for this task.

steps.title: Classify the release task
steps.instructions: Log the phase name for this task.

requirements.title: Menu code is construction
requirements.description: Logs the correct phase for writing the code that shows the menu

requirements.title: School choice is inception
requirements.description: Logs the correct phase for deciding which schools the app will serve

requirements.title: App structure is elaboration
requirements.description: Logs the correct phase for drawing the overall structure of the app

requirements.title: App store release is deployment
requirements.description: Logs the correct phase for putting the finished app in the app store
